top_signals.title: US Stocks Drop as Traders Parse Economic Data, Fedspeak
top_signals.summary: US stocks slipped on Tuesday as investors digested the first of several economic data releases scheduled for this week and heard from Federal Reserve officials.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Lundbeck Is Said to Express Interest in Xeris Biopharma
top_signals.summary: H Lundbeck A/S has expressed interest in acquiring Xeris Biopharma Holdings Inc., a commercial-stage drugmaker, people familiar with the matter said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Global Issuers on Funding Strategy
top_signals.summary: Randy Ewell, Senior Funding Officer, World Bank Group; Isabelle Laurent, Deputy Treasurer & Head of Funding, EBRD and Charles Perreault, Senior Director, Debt Management, Department of Finance Canada, discuss how global issuers are adapting funding programs to changing rates, geopolitical uncertainty and evolving investor demand, with Bloomberg’s Jorgelina Do Rosario at the 2026 Canadian Finance Conference.  (Source: Bloomberg)
